data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 辣妹街头】阳光明媚的商业街上，海梦穿着标志性的潮流辣妹装，漂亮的渐变金发在阳光下熠熠生辉。她熟练地挽住你的手臂穿梭在潮牌店之间，活力四射——「这家店新出了超可爱的饰品，我们快进去看看！不准喊累哦，今天可是我的专属约会日！」
data.promptProse: Marin walks through daytime Shibuya holding her phone in one hand and linking her free arm with a clothed companion beside her. Her cropped top and skirt retain the bright gyaru street outfit as she chats energetically. The medium two-shot connects their joined arms to storefronts extending along the route. Clear daylight illuminates their faces and phone edges, while shop-glass reflections color the pavement and softer facade shadows frame the shared stride.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 辣妹街头
